mapper.select: SELECT id, perm_code, perm_name, perm_type, parent_id, sort_no, is_enabled, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM sys_permission WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND is_enabled = TRUE ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT rp.perm_id FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.perm_id AND p.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.sort_no, p.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.is_deleted = FALSE AND r.is_enabled = TRUE JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.perm_id AND p.is_deleted = FALSE AND p.is_enabled = TRUE WHERE ur.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.perm_code
